description: The only IPC the connected server's pages get: moving and (on double-click) maximizing the window from elements they mark with `data-tauri-drag-region`. Needed because on macOS the title bar is a transparent overlay over the web app's header, which isn't draggable on its own. Both commands only act on a mouse gesture the user is already making, so granting them to any https origin (and http localhost, for development) exposes nothing.
